text:
priya: Quick check — candidate scheduled for Thu 9am PT (onsite + Zoom for remote). Two asks: 1) who can cover system-design panel at 9–9:40? 2) confirm if we can record for internal debriefs (candidate gave provisional consent, but legal wanted explicit note).

maya_k: I can cover design. I'm in EU but timezone works (I block 8:30–10am PT). Happy to take first 20m.

elena: I'll take the coding section (9:20–9:40) and run the takehome follow-up. Recording: we asked candidate earlier — they said yes for internal review only. People-ops, can you add a consent line to the calendar invite? :white_check_mark:

samir: small rubric question — are we weighting architecture higher than implementation? Last panel used 60/40 arch/code; team wants clarity for consistent scoring.

priya: good catch. Let's lock rubric weights at 55/45 (arch/code) for this role. I'll update the rubric doc and paste link.

priya: https://redwood.atlassian.com/ops/interviews/SD-engineer-rubric — updated section "weighting" added. Please thumbs-up if ok :thumbsup:

ben: quick heads up — I have a PR (#4321) that's blocking the interview environment provisioning (fixture seeds). If someone could review before 8pm PT that'd be ideal. @vikas or @samir?

vikas: I can review after I finish a deploy (around 6pm PT). If it's urgent, paste the diff here and I'll triage faster.

samir: I can take a look at the tests now, should be quick. Ben drop the PR link.

ben: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 — it's mostly seed ordering + one arg rename. I'm leaving notes in the PR.

hiring-bot: Calendar event updated by priya — "Interview: SD Engineer — recording consent noted". Invite attendees: maya_k, elena, samir, ben, vikas. Event id: evt_8791

maya_k: all set from my side. Will share a 2-slide prompt for design and a quick rubric anchor at start.

priya: thanks all — final checklist: add consent line to invite (done), rubric updated (done), PR review in flight (thanks samir/vikas). Ping here if anything changes before 8pm PT.
